title: A Minimal ASGI Application
learning_objectives: Describe the ASGI interface: scope, receive and send
Write an async application that sends a start message and a body message
Read a request body from receive() events
Call an ASGI app in-process, as a test client does
entry_point: async app(scope, receive, send); call_asgi(app, method, path, query_string=b'', body=b'', headers=None)
hints: Read the body with a loop: `chunks = []; more = True; while more: event = await receive(); chunks.append(event.get("body", b"")); more = event.get("more_body", False)`.
Keep a dict of path → allowed methods to decide between 404 and 405.
In `call_asgi`, define `async def receive(): return {"type": "http.request", "body": body, "more_body": False}` and a `send` that appends events to a list.

failure_feedback.advice: Send exactly one start event (status + headers) and then one body event.
Keep calling `receive()` while `more_body` is true and join the chunks.
Unknown path → 404; known path with the wrong method → 405; bad bodies → 400.
Build the scope, run the app with asyncio.run, and decode the recorded events.
Join every body event, and decode header byte pairs into strings.
